title: fix(spec,i18n): list the cloud ask_which tool and label it in every locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuHjL55LgwrUVHD9SjkARUPi)_

Fixes #34578

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Related: #37871 (D5 keeps the name `ask_which`), objectstack-ai/cloud#4773

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：云端问数助手的新工具 `ask_which`（问题有两三种读法时，反问用户再停下）登记进平台工具名单，并在 11 个语言包补上它的步骤标题，例如中文「确认问题含义」、英文 "Clarify the question"。
- 为什么：名单里没有这个名字，聊天里这一步的标题会退回英文原名 "Ask which"，中文对话里也一样。
- 出错会怎样：只多一个名字和一行文字，不改任何行为；可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无，座位复核即可。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`: `ask_which` joins `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` (alphabetical, after `apply_edit`); the group's doc comment names it (writes nothing, ends the turn with a question, cloud#4773).
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`: `chatbot.tool.ask_which`, beside `apply_edit`.
- Changeset `34578-ask-which-tool-label.md` (`@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch).

Cloud follow-up (card item 3): the `AHEAD_OF_REGISTRY` entry for `ask_which` in cloud `platform-tool-names-conformance` is deleted on the pin bump that carries this.

## Gates ran

- `packages/spec`: `platform-tool-names.test.ts` 12/12 passed.
- `ui`: `plugin-chatbot/.../toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts` + `i18n/.../all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` 66/66 passed. The rest of `packages/i18n` could not load locally (`@objectstack/formula` unbuilt in this container); CI runs it.
